notes: The inbox no longer says "No issues or pull requests" while its first fetch runs, and the rail's inbox dot lights only for items that wait on the user. Loading: `loading` was `!githubLoaded`, which flips as soon as the stored snapshot comes back from github.inbox, even one that has never been fetched (fetchedAt null, no repos) or has no rows yet for a workspace's repo, so the list fell through to the empty text until the open refresh landed. githubInboxLoading (inboxStore.ts) treats the GitHub source as loading until a fetch has landed for the repos in view: not loaded, or a never-fetched snapshot (or a repo absent from it) while the open view's refresh is pending or in flight; a fetched empty snapshot is a list and a login problem is a message, never a spinner. InboxView keeps the open refresh in state (`opened`) so the render between the stored snapshot and the effect counts as pending; the Linear source now waits on fetchedAt alone (its only exit is a fetch or an error), closing the same one-render hole. Badge: inboxBadge.ts applied the saved list filters and lit for any unseen change across every repo, so with 24 workspaces it never went out. inboxNeedsAttention (inboxStore.ts) is the pure predicate: open, and the viewer's review is requested, or it is assigned to them, or it is their own non-draft PR with CHANGES_REQUESTED, APPROVED, or FAILURE/ERROR checks; their own drafts never count; Linear items count when the stored list was fetched as "assigned to me" (the linear slice now records assignedToMe) and are not completed or canceled. The dot is "some attention item is unseen" over the stored snapshot only (no fetch), hidden workspaces stay out, the other list filters no longer reach it, and seeding still runs over every stored item so a fresh install stays dark. Limit: @-mentions are not in the snapshot, so a bare mention does not light the dot; no notifications fetch was added. Tests: inboxStore.test.ts (githubInboxLoading, inboxNeedsAttention on a sample snapshot), inboxBadge.test.ts (changed PR by someone else → no dot; review requested → dot, seen → no dot; own PR with changes requested → dot; own draft → no dot; hidden workspace → no dot; list filters ignored). Verified headlessly: typecheck, full vitest, and an esbuild-bundled node run of the predicate over a 24-repo snapshot (78 items, exactly 4 flagged).
